heading: Transferability, additional limitations, and definition
lead: The following provisions of subchapter I of this chapter apply to guarantees issued under this subchapter:

tree.text: Section 4972, relating to transferability of guarantees.
Subsections (b) and (c) of section 4973, providing limitations.
Section 4975(2), providing a definition of the term “cost”.
